Job details:
This Jobot Consulting Job is hosted by: Amanda Preston

Salary: $100 - $119 per hour

A bit about us:

We are a global media, technology, and information services organization with a diverse portfolio of businesses and a strong commitment to innovation. Our technology teams support a complex, enterprise-scale environment, leveraging modern infrastructure, cloud technologies, security platforms, and automation to improve how our businesses operate.

We are continuously investing in technology modernization, operational efficiency, and emerging capabilities, including AI-driven automation. Our teams work collaboratively across engineering, infrastructure, and cybersecurity to solve meaningful technical challenges and develop scalable, long-term solutions.

Why join us?

Fully Remote Opportunity: Work remotely from anywhere within the United States while collaborating with experienced engineering and security teams.

High-Impact Project: Take ownership of complex endpoint engineering challenges and deliver measurable improvements across an enterprise environment.

Modern Technology Stack: Work with Microsoft Intune, Iru/Kandji, CrowdStrike, Tenable, and enterprise automation technologies.

Automation-Focused Engineering: Build scalable solutions that eliminate recurring issues and reduce manual intervention.

Innovation & AI: Leverage scripting, APIs, data analytics, and AI-assisted engineering to improve endpoint management and security operations.

Ownership & Autonomy: Drive technical solutions from root-cause analysis through implementation, with the opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Job Details

We are seeking an experienced Senior Endpoint Automation Engineer for a six-month contract engagement focused on improving endpoint management health, vulnerability patching, and operational automation across enterprise Windows and macOS environments.

This is a highly hands-on engineering position designed to address persistent operational challenges through root-cause analysis, advanced scripting, data correlation, and automated remediation.

The successful candidate will work across Microsoft Intune, Iru/Kandji, Tenable, CrowdStrike, and related platforms to identify why endpoints fall out of management, diagnose patching failures, reconcile inconsistent compliance data, and implement automated solutions that prevent issues from recurring.

This is not a traditional endpoint administration, support, or architecture role. We are looking for an engineer who can investigate complex issues, build effective automation, and deliver measurable operational improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Management & Device Health

Investigate Windows and macOS devices that stop communicating with endpoint management platforms.

Establish automated monitoring to identify endpoints that fail to check in within defined timeframes.

Diagnose root causes involving agent health, connectivity, identity, certificates, configuration, and device state.

Develop automated workflows to identify, classify, and remediate inactive or noncompliant devices.

Automate the identification and removal of retired devices across MDM, directory, identity, and security platforms.

Improve endpoint inventory accuracy and eliminate stale or conflicting device records.

Patching & Vulnerability Management

Investigate operating system and application patching failures across Windows and macOS environments.

Identify and resolve the underlying causes of devices remaining unpatched beyond established SLAs.

Correlate data across Microsoft Intune, Iru/Kandji, Tenable, CrowdStrike, and inventory platforms to validate patch compliance.

Investigate discrepancies between endpoint management, security, and vulnerability reporting systems.

Build automated remediation, monitoring, and escalation workflows for patching failures.

Establish reliable compliance reporting that accurately reflects endpoint security and vulnerability exposure.

Automation & Process Improvement

Design, develop, and implement scalable automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, APIs, and existing enterprise tooling.

Replace repetitive manual processes with reliable, repeatable workflows.

Automate endpoint cleanup, agent remediation, patch troubleshooting, and compliance reporting.

Develop scripts and integrations to identify recurring issues and initiate corrective action.

Incorporate appropriate error handling, logging, validation, and exception management into automated workflows.

Document automated solutions and transfer knowledge to permanent engineering teams.

Data Analysis & AI-Assisted Engineering

Analyze large datasets from endpoint management, security, vulnerability, and ITSM platforms.

Correlate information across multiple systems to identify technical patterns and systemic failures.

Validate data accuracy rather than relying solely on existing dashboards or platform reporting.

Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools for investigation, scripting, analysis, and workflow development.

Ensure AI-generated solutions are technically validated and aligned with organizational security requirements.

Develop meaningful metrics and reporting to demonstrate improvements in endpoint health, compliance, and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

Strong enterprise-level endpoint engineering experience across Windows and macOS environments.

Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune.

Experience with Iru/Kandji, Jamf Pro, or comparable macOS management platforms.

Experience with Tenable, CrowdStrike, or similar vulnerability management and endpoint security tools.

Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash.

Demonstrated experience working with APIs and integrating data across multiple enterprise platforms.

Strong understanding of endpoint patch management, vulnerability remediation, and device compliance.

Experience troubleshooting endpoint agent failures, device communication issues, and inconsistent inventory records.

Proven ability to develop automated remediation workflows rather than relying on manual endpoint administration.

Experience analyzing and reconciling large, complex datasets from multiple management and security platforms.

Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to improve engineering, automation, and analysis workflows.

Excellent root-cause analysis, technical troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to independently own technical challenges from initial investigation through implementation and measurable resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing automated device lifecycle management and decommissioning processes.

Experience integrating endpoint management, vulnerability management, identity, and security tooling.

Familiarity with enterprise ITSM platforms and automated incident or remediation workflows.

Experience building operational dashboards, compliance reporting, and automated exception management.

Relevant Microsoft, Apple, endpoint management, security, or automation certifications.

What Success Looks Like

By the end of the engagement, the successful candidate will have delivered measurable improvements in three key areas:

1. Reliable Endpoint Visibility

Endpoints consistently check in within defined management windows.

Devices that fail to check in are automatically identified and classified by root cause.

Retired devices are automatically removed from relevant management, identity, and security platforms.

Stale records and unexplained device management gaps are eliminated or substantially reduced.

2. Accurate Patch Compliance

Patching failures are investigated and corrected at the root cause.

Conflicting data across endpoint management, vulnerability, and security platforms is reconciled.

Compliance reporting accurately reflects defined SLAs and provides leadership with reliable metrics.

Devices exceeding remediation deadlines are automatically identified and routed for corrective action.

3. Sustainable Automation

Repetitive cleanup, remediation, and reporting activities are automated.

Common agent failures, stale records, and patching issues are addressed through reusable workflows.

Manual intervention is limited to genuine exceptions.

Permanent engineering teams inherit documented, maintainable solutions that significantly reduce ongoing operational effort.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a hands-on endpoint engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and eliminating them through automation. You don't simply report what a dashboard says. You investigate the underlying data, identify why something is failing, and develop solutions that prevent it from happening again.

You are equally comfortable troubleshooting Windows and macOS management issues, writing scripts, integrating APIs, and validating information across multiple security and management platforms.

Most importantly, you are a builder and problem solver who measures success by the issues permanently resolved and the manual work eliminated.

Summary

Job Description

The Expert Software Engineer is a highly skilled technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced, scalable, and secure software solutions. This role leverages deep expertise in software engineering to solve complex problems, optimize system performance, and ensure the highest standards of code quality. The Expert Software Engineer collaborates with engineering teams and stakeholders, mentors peers, and drives innovation through continuous learning and application of best practices.

Job Duties

Design complex, scalable systems; review code; maintain technical documentation and diagrams ensuring best practices.
Resolve challenging issues; optimize performance and reliability; lead root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
Build cloud-native solutions; support CI/CD, automation, containerization; collaborate on infrastructure provisioning and monitoring.
Apply security best practices; mitigate risks; ensure compliance with standards and regulations.
Partner with stakeholders to deliver solutions; manage vendor integrations and technical evaluations.
Mentor engineers; share expertise; foster collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning culture.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or
High School Diploma/GED and 10 years preferred work experience.
7 years in software development, including experience with distributed systems and cloud platforms.
Expert proficiency in programming languages and API development (Java, C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript; REST/gRPC) with strong understanding of architectural patterns and system design.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
Expertise in databases (SQL and NoSQL) and advanced data management practices.
Deep knowledge of security principles, authentication, authorization, and compliance best practices.
Hands-on experience with DevOps tools and practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and logging (ELK Stack, Prometheus, Splunk).
Strong collaboration, communication, advanced analytical problem-solving skills, and ability to mentor and support engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
10 years with a track record of solving complex technical challenges and mentoring engineers.

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

Employee Entity

Thomas Jefferson University

1100 Virginia Drive, Fort Washington, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Nationally ranked, Jefferson, which is principally located in the greater Philadelphia region, Lehigh Valley and Northeastern Pennsylvania and southern New Jersey, is reimagining health care and higher education to create unparalleled value. Jefferson is more than 65,000 people strong, dedicated to providing the highest-quality, compassionate clinical care for patients; making our communities healthier and stronger; preparing tomorrow's professional leaders for 21st-century careers; and creating new knowledge through basic/programmatic, clinical and applied research. Thomas Jefferson University, home of Sidney Kimmel Medical College, Jefferson College of Nursing, and the Kanbar College of Design, Engineering and Commerce, dates back to 1824 and today comprises 10 colleges and three schools offering 200+ undergraduate and graduate programs to more than 8,300 students. Jefferson Health, nationally ranked as one of the top 15 not-for-profit health care systems in the country and the largest provider in the Philadelphia and Lehigh Valley areas, serves patients through millions of encounters each year at 32 hospitals campuses and more than 700 outpatient and urgent care locations throughout the region. Jefferson Health Plans is a not-for-profit managed health care organization providing a broad range of health coverage options in Pennsylvania and New Jersey for more than 35 years.

Proven ability to develop automated remediation workflows rather than relying on manual endpoint administration.

Experience analyzing and reconciling large, complex datasets from multiple management and security platforms.

Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to improve engineering, automation, and analysis workflows.

Excellent root-cause analysis, technical troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to independently own technical challenges from initial investigation through implementation and measurable resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing automated device lifecycle management and decommissioning processes.

Experience integrating endpoint management, vulnerability management, identity, and security tooling.

Familiarity with enterprise ITSM platforms and automated incident or remediation workflows.

Experience building operational dashboards, compliance reporting, and automated exception management.

Relevant Microsoft, Apple, endpoint management, security, or automation certifications.

What Success Looks Like

By the end of the engagement, the successful candidate will have delivered measurable improvements in three key areas:

1. Reliable Endpoint Visibility

Endpoints consistently check in within defined management windows.

Devices that fail to check in are automatically identified and classified by root cause.

Retired devices are automatically removed from relevant management, identity, and security platforms.

Stale records and unexplained device management gaps are eliminated or substantially reduced.

2. Accurate Patch Compliance

Patching failures are investigated and corrected at the root cause.

Conflicting data across endpoint management, vulnerability, and security platforms is reconciled.

Compliance reporting accurately reflects defined SLAs and provides leadership with reliable metrics.

Devices exceeding remediation deadlines are automatically identified and routed for corrective action.

3. Sustainable Automation

Repetitive cleanup, remediation, and reporting activities are automated.

Common agent failures, stale records, and patching issues are addressed through reusable workflows.

Manual intervention is limited to genuine exceptions.

Permanent engineering teams inherit documented, maintainable solutions that significantly reduce ongoing operational effort.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a hands-on endpoint engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and eliminating them through automation. You don't simply report what a dashboard says. You investigate the underlying data, identify why something is failing, and develop solutions that prevent it from happening again.

You are equally comfortable troubleshooting Windows and macOS management issues, writing scripts, integrating APIs, and validating information across multiple security and management platforms.

Most importantly, you are a builder and problem solver who measures success by the issues permanently resolved and the manual work eliminated.
